Title: keystone kine at obf vs bleed reduction

Messages.Author: TorranceCircle
Messages.Body:
Name: Keystone Kine
[TR:C]
Cardtype: Action
Discipline: Celerity/Necromancy/Obfuscate
Requires an anarch.
[cel] and/or [nec] and/or [obf]  Bleed. If using [cel], he or she gains 1 blood. If using [nec], the bleed is at +1 bleed. If using [obf] and this action is successful, you may burn an ally controlled by your prey whose cost is not greater than the bleed amount.Artist: Peter Bergting

If I KK bleed at obf and it is reduced to zero, can I burn an ally that costs zero?

I think I can, but my understanding may be wrong. I think a bleed that resolves for zero is considered a succesful action but not a succesful bleed.

Messages.Author: Wedge
Messages.Body: But, the action is and that all Keystone  cares about.

Messages.Author: Juggernaut1981
Messages.Body:
IANPB but my answer would be "Yes". It does not require a successful bleed, only a successful action.

Retired Baron of Sydney, Australia, 418
